response:
I have upgraded the **Arc HUD** extension to the full interactive sci-fi HUD experience with real WebUI data.

### Summary of Changes

#### 1. Extension Manifest ([`extension.json`](file:///opt/data/spikes/hermes-webui/extensions-src/arc-hud/extension.json))
- Incremented version to `0.2.0`.
- Configured `"dom": { "owned": true, "mutates_core_views": true }` to declare DOM injection and composer control relocation.
- Set `"network_external": false`.
- Declared read permissions for internal WebUI APIs: `/api/dashboard/status`, `/api/usage`, `/api/sessions`, `/api/system/health`, and `/api/sessions/events`.

#### 2. Interactive Overlay Script ([`arc-hud.js`](file:///opt/data/spikes/hermes-webui/extensions-src/arc-hud/assets/arc-hud.js))
- **Lifecycle & State Observer**: Configured a `MutationObserver` on `document.documentElement` watching `data-skin`. Activates the HUD when `data-skin === 'arc-hud'` and cleanly tears it down when switching away to any other skin.
- **Central Arc Reactor Graphic**: Generated a responsive, high-detail multi-ring SVG featuring 10 magnetic power coils, counter-rotating mechanical turbine rings, targeting reticles, and a pulsing central core.
- **Top-Left (Core Telemetry // SYS.01)**:
  - Fetches `/api/dashboard/status`, `/api/settings`, `/api/system/health`, and `/api/usage` periodically (every 10 seconds).
  - Displays real Hermes Core version, online/standby status, active stream runtime, active session count, total accumulated tokens (with input/output breakdown), and a real-time ticking uptime counter (every second).
- **Top-Right (Tactical Radar // SCAN.04)**:
  - Renders a 130px tactical radar display with a 360° conical gradient sweep animation.
  - Dynamically calculates radar coordinates and generates blips mapped from real active and recent sessions retrieved from `/api/sessions`.
  - Displays target count, sector lock on the active/newest session, ping timestamps, and a tactical target range list.
- **Bottom-Right (Telemetry Matrix // STREAM.LOG)**:
  - Subscribes via `EventSource` to `/api/sessions/events` (SSE).
  - Appends live timestamped log entries for session changes, stream acknowledgments, active runs, and UI interaction telemetry.
  - Auto-scrolls with memory bounded to the latest 60 entries.
- **Bottom-Left (Subsystem Controls // COMPOSER)**:
  - Relocates the real `.composer-left` element into the HUD panel via placeholder anchoring, ensuring all native controls (Attach, Saved Prompts, Voice/Mic, Profile Chip, Workspace Group, Model Chip & select, Reasoning, Toolsets, YOLO) remain 100% functional.
  - Automatically restores `.composer-left` back into `.composer-footer` when deactivating.
- **Send Pulse**: Preserved and connected the Arc Reactor firing burst animation on `#btnSend` submission.

#### 3. HUD Styling & Architecture ([`arc-hud.css`](file:///opt/data/spikes/hermes-webui/extensions-src/arc-hud/assets/arc-hud.css))
- **Layout & Transparency**: Hides `.sidebar` (`display: none !important`) and sets `.layout`, `.main`, `#mainChat`, and `#messages` to transparent backgrounds. Chat message bubbles are styled with semi-transparent dark glass (`backdrop-filter: blur(8px)`) so the central Arc Reactor shines through behind them.
- **Corner Panels**: Styled with cyan hairline borders, amber corner brackets (`::before`/`::after`), glass backdrop blur, and high-tech typography.
- **Composer Chrome**: Centers `#composerBox` under the chat viewport with `.composer-right` and the Arc Reactor `#btnSend` button.
- **Responsive & Accessibility**: Includes responsive breakpoints down to mobile/tablet widths and `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` support.
